name: FSAR-Cap
description: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image captioning enables scene-level semantic understanding and plays a crucial role in applications such as military intelligence and urban planning, but its development is limited by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. To address this, we present FSAR-Cap, a large-scale SAR captioning dataset with 14,480 images and 72,400 image-text pairs. FSAR-Cap is built on the FAIR-CSAR detection dataset and constructed through a two-stage annotation strategy that combines hierarchical template-based representation, manual verification and supplementation, prompt standardization. Compared with existing resources, FSAR-Cap provides richer fine-grained annotations, broader category coverage, and higher annotation quality. Benchmarking with multiple encoder-decoder architectures verifies its effectiveness, establishing a foundation for future research in SAR captioning and intelligent image interpretation.
evaluation_method: BLEU, CIDEr, SPICE, and human evaluation
reputation: A newly introduced SAR captioning dataset that appears promising but is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Multimodal remote-sensing captioning benchmark with a relatively large synthetic/annotated dataset; likely limited prior saturation and some domain-specific annotation bias.
